change_is_not_improvement: A change that accepts E2/H5 is initially only a behavior change. It becomes an improvement only after passing these safety rules and the measurements designated therein. A disappeared known error is not success.
derived_from: Ast F operating targets (FA priority, 2x2 reporting)
Ast D goods-flip lesson (E2+H5 flipped together: narrow fixes can have wide effects)
diagnostic_status: DESIGN ONLY - defines gates; tests nothing; changes nothing
hard_disqualifiers_mechanical_not_interp: a reproducibly rejected FALSE case (F1/F2) flips to ACCEPT -> False-Accept-Regression
an existing TRUE-ACCEPT anchor flips to SILENCE without an explicitly approved trade-off rule
provenance/trail requirements violated (missing fields, unbound provider, lost raw)
technical failures or parser errors appear where none existed before
frozen prompt/pipeline changed outside the explicitly tested change scope
headline_scores_forbidden: no overall accuracy/F1-style buyout: e.g. +3 TRUE_ACCEPT with +1 FALSE_ACCEPT FAILS even if any aggregate score rises (Ast F: FA outranks FN)
recall_anchors_not_free_pass: E2/H5 acceptance is the desired direction, but H5 must be evaluated separately (Ast D showed joint flips); E2 fixed alone != H validated

reference_set_frozen_role.warning: these six cases are NOT sufficient evidence for general validator quality; never upgrade them into a validation benchmark
